individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A is a set of pseudocoloured micrographs (time-lapse confocal images), not a plot showing averaged data, so individual data points are not applicable.

The main graphs are scatter plots showing individual normalized-intensity measurements over time (points are the raw data), and the insets are line/scatter plots of averaged early time-point responses with error bars; both scatter and line plots are exempt from requiring an additional overlay of individual data points.

error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: not needed - Panel A contains only micrographs with no error bars or box-plot elements.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Insets represent average early time points responses measured in euchromatin and heterochromatin (red and green data sets, respectively) to emphasize on the initial plateau in heterochromatin.
error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: FAIL - Error bars are visible on the inset data points (averaged early time-point responses) but the caption does not specify what they represent (e.g., SD, SEM, or CI, or the number of replicates averaged).
